manual_web_review.method: Manual public web search/open. Fifteen published source bodies inspected: ten English letter pages, three Hebrew letter pages, one English translated excerpt from a Yiddish letter, and one correspondence dossier. No crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text reproduction.
manual_web_review.deduplication_check: Fifteen AIDs checked against the current 8,986-entry public search index and 1,050-item review queue. No exact AID/URL duplicate or queued candidate found. Distinct letters received distinct Evidence Families; the Reagan dossier is one correspondence family. AID 2190037 (transcribed copy) and AID 2313660 (English translation from Yiddish) are explicitly non-independent.
source_languages: Yiddish (underlying language identified through English translated excerpt; original Yiddish not inspected)
limitations: Nine English letter pages do not label the body as a translation; original language/autograph not independently established.
AIDs 4096316, 1858362 and 1861674 are excerpts; propositions are restricted to visible excerpts.

AID 2313660 is an English excerpt from a Yiddish letter; original Yiddish and full letter were not inspected; translation is non-independent.
Hebrew AIDs 2989328, 2989329 and 4279887 were inspected in HTML; linked PDFs were used only for printed pagination/identity, not semantic content; autographs not inspected.
AID 4380025 does not display a date and itself limits its explanation to the scope of a letter.
AID 142535 is a multi-document dossier; only Rebbe-authored passages are paraphrased; presidential texts are third-party context.
No full copyrighted text was copied.
